verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex israel, tato ay junok ix ix spuk sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum, syik'an junokxo winh ix, tato spukxi sb'a ix yet' winh schab'il chi', a winh yetb'eyum ix chi', maxtzak yal yik'lanxi sb'a winh yet' ix. Tato syik'lajxi sb'a heb' jun, a lum lum tik sjuwiel lum t'a yol in sat. Palta a in Jehová in tik swala' to lajan ix eyutej he b'a icha heb' ix ajmul ix tzijtum swinak, haxo tiknaik, tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxikot t'ayin.

K'eanhek k'elan t'a lum tzalkixtak manhxalaj ste'al, scham eyilan lum jolomtak tzalan chi'. ¿Tok ayto lum tzalan chi' b'aj maj he k'ulej ajmulal? Tzex em k'ojan t'a titak b'e tze maklan yek' heb' tzex mulan chi' yet'ok, icha tz'aj smaklan heb' árabe yek' heb' tzek' b'aj malaj anima. Yuj eyajmulal chi' ix eyixtejb'at lum lum tik.
Yuj wal he mul chi' maxtzak yak' nhab' t'a stiempoal. Icha heb' ix ajmul ix maxtzak k'ixwi jab'ok, icha wal chi' eyaji.
Ina hato eyalan tik t'ayin: Mamin, wach' ak'an ket'ok yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto.
¿Tom aynhejkot owal t'ayonh? ¿Tom aynhejkot owal chi' t'a junelnhej? xe chi. Yakb'an wan eyalan icha chi', wannhej pax he k'ulan jantak tas malaj swach'il stechaj he k'ulani, xchi Jehová.

Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj rey Josías, ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: ¿Ix am wal il tas ix sk'ulej heb' etchonhab' israel? Icha wal heb' ix ajmul ix ix yutej sb'a heb'. Ix laj b'at heb' sk'ulej ajmulal t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.

Ha in tik, a tzin na'ani to ayik toxo ix sk'ulej heb' icha chi', ol meltzajpaxkot heb' t'ayin, palta maj meltzajxikot heb'. Ha chonhab' Judá te pit, ix yil tas sk'ulej chonhab' Israel ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok.
Ix yilanpax heb' to ix in puk in b'a yet' heb' israel yuj yajmulal, palta a heb' aj Judá chi' maj xiw jab'ok heb', ix empax heb' ajmulal.
Yujto malaj yelk'och ajmulal t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yixtejb'at lum lum tik heb' yuj smul chi', yuj pax to ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios nab'a k'e'en, nab'a te'.
Wach'chom ix yil heb' tas ix aj heb' israel chi', manh yujok chi' ix meltzajxikot heb' t'ayin t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, palta tonhej ix stz'ak meltzajkot sb'a heb' t'ayin, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel te pit heb', palta kennhej wal smul heb' t'a yichanh heb' aj Judá. Ha heb' aj Judá chi' maj yak' elk'och tas ix yal heb'.

Ach Jeremías, ixik k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzalanb'at jun lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal ay t'a norte chi'. Ha wal Jehová tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Ex israel te pit, meltzajanhekxikot t'ayin. Manh owalok ol wutej ex in cha'ani, manh masanilok tiempo aykot wowal t'ayex, yujto tz'ok' in k'ol t'ayex.

Anhej to tzeyojtakejel he chukal, to te pit ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik. Ha in swala' to ix och he mul he k'ulan ajmulal yet' juntzanh komon Dios t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il. Maj he k'anab'ajej jab'ok in cheknab'il, xchi Jehová t'ayex, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex in chonhab' te pit, meltzajanhekxi t'ayin, yujto eyetb'eyum waji. Junjun ex ol ex wik'kot t'a junjun chonhab'. Chatakwanh ol aj ex wik'ankot t'a junjun makan inhtilal. Icha chi' ol aj ex wik'anxikankot t'a Sion.
Ol wak'och heb' eyilumal icha wal in gana, haxo heb' ol ak'an yajalil t'a eyib'anh t'a jelanil yet' t'a sjichanil.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ayik toxo ix k'ib'xi he b'isul t'a he chonhab' tik, manhxa b'aj ol eyak' b'inaj te' skaxail in trato. Manhxa b'aj ol he nakot te', manhxo pax olto jawok te' t'a he pensar. Manhxo ol he b'o junokxo sk'exul te'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a Jerusalén ol alchaj yuj to in despacho yaj a in Jehová in tik. Masanil chonhab' ol smolb'ej sb'a t'a tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Manhxo ol yak' sb'a heb' skuchb'ajb'at yuj schuk pensaril.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', junxonhej ol aj chonhab' Judá yet' chonhab' Israel. Junxonhej ol aj he meltzajkot t'a jun nación t'a stojolal norte, haxo he jawikan kajan t'a lum lum wak'nak smakb'enej heb' he mam eyicham.

Ex israel, ix in na' to tzex in chaoch wuninalok, swak'an jun lum te nib'ab'il tik t'ayex. Anhej wal jun lum tik te wach' yilji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ix in na' to ol in eyal he mamok t'a junelnhej, manhxo ol in eyaktejkan walani.
Palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to icha junok ix ix te chuk t'a winh yetb'eyum, icha chi' ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin.

Tz'ab'chaj yoch jaj t'a lum tzalkixtak manhxa ste'al, haton heb' israel tz'el yaw yok'i sk'anan kolwal heb'. Ix elkan heb' t'a sb'e'al tojolal. Ix in b'at satk'olal yuj heb', a in Jehová sDiosal in heb' tik.

Ex anima te pit, kotanhekxi t'ayin, ol wik'anel jun pitalil ayoch t'a he pensar chi', xchi Jehová chi'. Ix tak'wi heb' israel chi' icha tik: Ina kajek' tik, skak'och ko b'a t'a yol a k'ab', yujto a ach tik Jehová ko Diosal ach.
Nab'anhej onh xit'ek' t'a tzalkixtak, onh awaj cha'anh kak'an k'inh t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Anhej wal t'ayach Jehová ko Diosal tz'ilchaj ko kolnab'il.

Yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto, onh och ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel k'ixwub'tak chi', yuj chi' ix ak' satel tastak ix aj t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Ix champax yuninal heb' yet' yisil heb'.

Kik'ek em ko b'a yuj k'ixwelal, yujto a onh tik yet' heb' ko mam kicham, ix te och wal ko mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto masanto tiknaik, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syal t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
